description: This source file defines a JUnit-based test class for creating and exporting a subset of database tables into an XML dataset for testing or data initialization purposes within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: CreateInitialDataSet
classes.description: A JUnit test class that generates an XML dataset from the current database context for use in testing or data loading within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: shouldCreateInitialTestDataSetXmlFile
methods.description: Creates an XML dataset file containing selected tables from the current database connection, for use in testing or data setup.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Overrides the base method to specify that this test should not use an in-memory database, but rather the database defined by runtime properties.
